reason: The zoo is free but it's no help when it's cold or raining, and a gated spot for my baby with a seat for me sounds good. Free first visit means I'll try it on a Saturday, and if it's calm I'd pay $15 once or twice, not a membership.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? And $15 every Saturday adds up when the zoo costs nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing on my free visit that the Baby Nook really keeps the older kids out and it isn't crowded; a weekend-only price around $10 would make me come back more often.
